QUOTE: Routing is by extension and, for `CMakeLists.txt`, by whole filename, so `oldCMakeLists.txt` is not claimed; table row "`.sh`, `.bash`" and "`CMakeLists.txt`, `.cmake`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the shell extensions (.sh, .bash) and CMake (.cmake) and explicitly says CMakeLists.txt is matched by whole file name rather than extension.
